### 🏷️ Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability (non-breaking)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates or typo corrections
- [ ] `test`: Adding or expanding test suites
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without changing behavior
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependency, or build configuration updates
- [ ] `BREAKING CHANGE`: Changes that break existing API behavior
